Hi team,

Following our calibration conversation last week, I'm attaching a consolidated summary for Priya N.'s biannual review and a draft transition plan in case we proceed with the role change we discussed. Short summary: Priya is being considered for a team lead role on the infra foundations squad; we need manager notes + an agreed handover plan in case leadership greenlights the move.

What I need from you by EOD Monday (Oct 4):
- Aditya: your updated manager notes (bullet strengths, 2 areas of improvement, suggested calibration band).
- Mina: confirm the preferred start window for the change and whether we should include a short severance/notice clause in the offer packet.
- Lauren: draft short-form OKRs (3) that Priya would inherit in Q4 and a proposed ownership/mentor for each.

Attachments: transition_draft_v1.pdf (PDF, 48KB); performance_summary_q3.xlsx (XLSX, 120KB).

High-level constraints: leadership wants minimal disruption to active projects (esp. KV-cache rollout), so handover should be no longer than 6 weeks. We should also surface any vendor dependencies that would complicate a quick swap.

I copied Olivia from PeoplePartner to flag that we'll likely need a template for the transition agreement and to coordinate any employment paperwork. If anyone needs more time, please call out now — otherwise I'll package this to HR on Tuesday.

Thanks,
